servo.note: the two blades load the cam equal and opposite: the spline sees only the friction imbalance (no outboard pin); at squeezed the cam is off the blades (the springs hold, servo unloaded)

head_body.note: alt D: a push pad under the XT60 end cuts the insert moment, the pull still loads the grip (5.3 N.m); frame model: the mate tilt barely moves (Scout 0.822 -> 0.817 deg), so D is not taken

pinion.note: research: module 1 is the printable limit; pinion v3 teeth Y 59.75..72.75 on rack teeth Y 59.25..73.25 (grown down: the top stays under the carriage-lane keep-out 73.75, concept review r3); on the rack tail (drone insert) the engaged face is 9.75 from the tail's step at Y 63 (swap_system)

A sprung blades + servo cam (chosen).parts: 2 springs, 2 carbon rods along x, 2 blade guide bosses 16 long, metal horn

B servo toggle fingers.servo_torque_kgcm: ~0.5 at the squeeze, rises near dead centre
B servo toggle fingers.note: needs a tuned stop per pack (the Scout / Overseer tabs differ in release force); a stop error loses the lock or overloads the servo; more parts

C v4 servo fingers.note: the servo holds the grip; a power cut drops the pack; the spline takes the pull side load (no published limit)

D A + push pad.note: a pad under the XT60 end: the insert moment on the head body drops (Scout 6.8 -> 3.6 N.m) but the pull still loads the grip (5.3) and the mate tilt barely moves (0.822 -> 0.817 deg): an extra contact for little; not taken
